content:
lisa_product: Quick design review: run compare pane — ordering + screen reader announce + CTA copy. Sharing mock: https://staging.redwood.design/mock/abcd (ignore staging data)

aria_ux: Mostly layout LGTM but two P1s: (1) primary CTA ordering — current mock shows `Approve changes` on the right and `View diffs` on the left; we should decide visual vs. focus order. Thoughts?

samir_eng: From a11y/keyboard standpoint the primary action should be first focusable after the results header. Right now tab order lands on diff toggles. Screenshot attached.

maya_devexp: I prefer primary visually on the right but tabbable first to show emphasis — that could be confusing if visual order != tab order.

jonah_research: Quick user test: 8/10 expected to inspect diffs first. They tended to click 'View diffs' before approving. Maybe make 'View diffs' default focusable.

aria_ux: If so, change copy to make intent clear: `View diffs` (primary) and `Approve changes` (secondary) vs current `Approve changes` phrasing. Also keyboard users need clear focus ring.

a11y-bot: Accessibility note: when a run completes announce to SRs: "Run comparison complete. 3 differences found." Use `aria-live="polite"` on the summary element and avoid double announcements on re-renders.

samir_eng: Implementation: add an offscreen element role="status" aria-atomic="true" and debounce updates to avoid spamming SRs.

lisa_product: Copy decision to pick: `View diffs` + `Approve changes`? 'Approve run' sounds odd. Open to research input.

jonah_research: In workshops participants used "Approve changes" more naturally. I vote that.

maya_devexp: :thumbsup: Also flag: diff badge colors low contrast at small sizes — ping @aria_ux to check tokens and outlines.

aria_ux: I'll update palette and add 1px neutral outline on focus/hover. Proposed tokens: diff-green `#0f7a3a`, diff-purple `#5b2e8a`.

samir_eng: Dev nit: expandable prompt preview truncates mid-word. Prefer word-boundary truncation + ellipsis. For short lines we can use CSS `text-overflow: ellipsis`; for multi-line maybe JS clamp.

lisa_product: Action items: @aria_ux update mock + color tokens; @samir_eng add aria-live region, fix truncation; @jonah_research update research notes. Plan: ship to canary next sprint.

maya_devexp: Added to sprint board. Will follow up on PR reviews.
